title: Vendor 19B4 / DevDataUrtu1920 Short-ASCII layout
summary: Vendor 19B4.xml / DevDataUrtu1920 documents fixed MP/Q1/MD widths, Q1 columns, a 20-byte firmware field without inverter serial, optional F/RH/RB layouts, and segment-7 charge/discharge multiply=0.1. It qualifies the EyeBond Short-ASCII family dialect, not a retail commercial model.
